name: celestial-surge-damage|Celestial Surge adds 10% to the damage of consuming Scattered Stars (#928)
contract: Celestial Surge 680773 (Spell.dbc, SpellFamilyName 32, passive 0x1c0) has effect 0 = SPELL_AURA_ADD_PCT_MODIFIER (108) with EffectMiscValue SPELLMOD_DAMAGE (0), EffectSpellClassMask word1 0x800 and EffectBasePoints 9, resolving to 10 with DieSides 1, matching 'Increases the damage dealt by consuming Scattered Stars by $s1%'. The consuming hit is Scattered Star 804995 (SpellFamilyFlags word1 0x800, effect 0 SCHOOL_DAMAGE, Arcane), which carries SPELL_ATTR3_DO_NOT_DISPLAY_RANGE (0x40000000) but not SPELL_ATTR3_IGNORE_CASTER_MODIFIERS (0x20000000). Native path only: Unit::SpellDamageBonusDone ends with ApplySpellMod(SPELLMOD_DAMAGE) on the total, so the result scales by exactly 1.10 whatever spell power the fixture has; the spell_damage_done metric calls it with a fixed base of 1000. Lunar Lance rank 9 502340 (word1 0x2000000, also Arcane) has a different class mask and must not move, which shows the modifier is scoped to the Scattered Star hit. Both fixtures are the same race, class and level.
